BiblicalUsage: The name is Roeh, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 2:52: "…Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Roeh matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
